# The graded-deposit sweep — 2026-08-17

Decision 17, checkpoint 2. **Spike only**: nothing here is adopted, no default is changed, no threshold is touched.

Field 60×40, 2141 nodes, 4078 edges. BFS **101** round the wall, **51** through the gap (zone to zone) — ratio 1.980.
h = 2, k = 20, floor = 0, untouched. Window 300 trips, minimum 65.
